findings.title: Already-paused custom message corrupts unfinished tool batch
findings.actual: After pause: pendingCustom=0; transcript system/custom/assistant/toolResult/custom. Resume: Resumable tool batch has unexpected trailing message; effects=[one], provider fixture calls=1.
findings.expected: Keep the new custom message deferred until the entire batch is complete; remaining effect two must execute exactly once.
findings.why: isStreaming is false after cooperative pause, so triggerTurn:false falls through to _appendCustomMessage even though the assistant tool batch is incomplete.
findings.suggestion: Treat paused unfinished turns as deferred message ingestion boundaries. Snapshot raw new messages and flush only after full batch settlement. Add both same-instance and checkpoint-restored arrival coverage.
findings.original_finding: M0-R2 remains open beyond its original reproducer

findings.title: Pause during prepareNextTurn repeats preparation on restore
findings.actual: Pause requested while awaited prepareNextTurn is gated. It finishes once; next steering poll throws pause. Snapshot retains afterTurn. Restore/resume invokes preparation again: prepares=2, model fixture calls=2.
findings.expected: The successfully completed next-turn preparation must commit once; restore resumes the prepared request.
findings.why: Continuation only distinguishes tools and afterTurn. The returned preparation state is local and no prepared-next-request phase is committed before the later pause fence.
findings.suggestion: Persist a completed preparation phase and its context/model/thinking/message outputs, with queue consumption position. Resume it without reexecuting compaction or extension preparation.
findings.original_finding: M0-R4 original skip fixed, exactly-once boundary remains open

findings.title: Pause during ordinary assistant response loses finishTurn and continuation decision
findings.actual: Pause while first fixture response is in flight, then settle ordinary assistant with no tools. Resume finishes immediately: finishTurn=0, model fixture calls=1. Default control requires finishTurn=2 and calls=2.
findings.expected: Run the pending finishTurn once and honor its continue/end decision before declaring the resumed run settled.
findings.why: The new pre-finish fence interrupts after message_end; a non-tool assistant clears continuation, and resumePaused returns for trailing assistant without queued messages.
findings.suggestion: Record a pending-finish phase for every assistant response, including no-tool responses, before honoring pause. Persist and resume its finish decision exactly once.
findings.original_finding: New V2 regression caused by the pre-finish pause fence
